comment: Segments to extract from baserom.gba into labeled asm (tools/split.py).
labels come from docs/analysis/symbols.csv. For every segment listed
here, make split writes asm/<name>.s (verified byte-identical against
the ROM) and removes the data/<name>.s incbin slice; linker.ld already
pins each section by name, so no linker script change is needed.
external_defined lists symbols that already exist as real labels in the
link (asm/crt0.s, src/agb_sram.c, data/sdk_libc.s) and therefore must
NOT be redefined as absolute symbols in asm/rom_syms.s.
